name: cpp-to-rust
description: This project demonstrates how to call Rust code from C++.

scripts.build:ios: rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios && cargo build --target aarch64-apple-ios --release && rustup target add x86_64-apple-ios && cargo build --target x86_64-apple-ios --release
scripts.build:android: cargo install cargo-ndk && cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -t armeabi-v7a -t x86_64 build --release
